title: A dictionary learning framework for graphs via filters and optimal transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.05919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a graph dictionary learning (GDL) framework where each graph is represented as a zero-mean Gaussian distribution derived from its filtered Laplacian. Each observed graph is approximated by a barycenter over learned atom graphs, computed under the filter graph distance (fGOT), a graph comparison metric sensitive to global structural properties. The reconstruction error between the observed graph and its barycenter is measured by the surrogate fGOT (sfGOT) distance, a tractable approximation of fGOT that handles graphs without known node correspondence, and is minimized end-to-end via backpropagation. We further provide a novel interpretation of sfGOT through the lens of the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, showing that minimizing the sfGOT distance between two graphs is equivalent to maximizing statistical dependence between the spectral embedding of their nodes. translated_title: 基于滤波器和最优传输的图字典学习框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种图字典学习（GDL）框架，其中每个图被表示为由其滤波拉普拉斯矩阵导出的零均值高斯分布。每个观测图通过在学到的原子图上计算的重心（barycenter）来近似，该计算基于滤波图距离（fGOT），这是一种对全局结构性质敏感的图比较度量。观测图与其重心之间的重构误差由代理滤波图距离（sfGOT）来度量，它是fGOT的一种易于处理的近似，能够处理没有已知节点对应关系的图，并通过反向传播进行端到端的最小化。我们进一步通过希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion）的视角为sfGOT提供了新颖的解释，表明最小化两个图之间的sfGOT距离等价于最大化其节点谱嵌入之间的统计依赖性。在基准数据集上的实验展示了有竞争力的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于滤波图距离与最优传输的图字典学习框架，将图表示为滤波拉普拉斯导出的高斯分布，通过可端到端优化的sfGOT距离实现图的重构，并从HSIC视角给出了新的理论解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph dictionary learning framework based on filter graph distance and optimal transport, which represents graphs as Gaussian distributions derived from filtered Laplacians, enables end-to-end graph reconstruction via a tractable sfGOT distance, and provides a novel theoretical interpretation through the lens of the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion.
